download_blender3B_1024_model: download the Blender3B_1024 model to the specified datapath directory using the download function
check_model_built_status: check if the Blender3B_1024 model is already built using the built function from parlai core
get_model_directory: get the model directory path for the Blender3B_1024 model using get_model_dir from parlai core
download_models_from_msc: download model files from the msc source using download_models with version and model type options
review_download_function: review the download function to understand how it checks build status and downloads the Blender3B_1024 model
